facts.value: Entry obtains Crazy Hand attributes, copies X from the position returned by ftBossLib_8015C208, assigns Y from xE0, and clears all self velocity. Animation exhaustion clears X velocity and forwards the same GObj to ftCh_Init_8015A184. IASA queries the player slot and calls an empty boss hook only for Human slots. Physics forwards xDC to ftBossLib_8015BF74. After obtaining a target position, that helper computes x_diff = target X minus current X; if ABS(x_diff) > xDC it adds (x_diff > 0 ? xDC : -xDC) to existing horizontal self velocity, otherwise it adds x_diff. No positivity validation for xDC is shown. Collision performs no work.
facts.rationale: Preserves the explicit lifecycle data flow while replacing unsupported input-processing language with the verified no-op hook. States the additive physics branch exactly rather than implying a speed assignment or guaranteed target-directed increment for unchecked xDC.

evidence.why: Complete object, attribute, callback and continuation flow.
Exact strict-comparison branch and additive horizontal-velocity operations; no parameter-sign validation.

facts.value: Implements Crazy Hand's internal Cancel lifecycle: enters literal motion state 0x177, initializes position and velocity, hands off on animation exhaustion, delegates horizontal tracking physics through xDC, and provides an inert collision callback. Its human-slot IASA path invokes a currently empty hook rather than implementing input handling.
